name: fleet-console
_test: The `test` script runs packages one at a time. The boundary-enforcement suites in adapters, server, simulator and web lint files on disk, so a parallel workspace run writes the tree underneath them; that produced five transient failures in one day (packages/FIXME.md F14). Serialising cost three to five seconds across the whole workspace when measured, which is not enough to buy a flake in the one guard that proves the boundaries fire.

scripts.check:ci: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm check:architecture-docs && pnpm check:type-safety && pnpm check:doc-comments && pnpm check:tokens && pnpm check:dependencies && pnpm audit --audit-level=high --ignore-registry-errors && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm record:fixtures && git diff --exit-code -- 'packages/adapters/src/vendors/*/__fixtures__/*.json' && pnpm check:diff-size && pnpm check:bundle
scripts.check:tokens: node --test scripts/checkTokens.test.mjs scripts/generateWebTokens.test.mjs scripts/webTokenLint.test.mjs && pnpm --filter web test:token-lint && node scripts/generateWebTokens.mjs --check && node scripts/checkTokens.mjs
scripts.clean: pnpm --recursive exec rm -rf dist coverage node_modules/.tmp
